config.authorization_basis: current user's active gravity research goal; this is a new development study, not reuse of an older single-run authorization or an untouched confirmation test
config.claim_ceiling: QUALITY_LIMITED_EVIDENCE_RETAINED; no family pruning, independent replication, galaxy success, lensing prediction or full Solar System pass

alternate_diagnostics: native covariance with the exact mean-profile normalization
covariance.primary_diagnostic: native pressure correlation matrix transferred to the high-level quoted errors; an explicit unverified covariance-mapping assumption
covariance.radius_mapping: index-wise constant radius dilation only; all bin ratios and mean-profile ratios must be constant within 1e-8; record factors; nonuniform bin changes fail; astrophysical cause not established

config.nuisance_role: 21 fixed global scenarios, not per-object tuning, probability intervals, a joint posterior, or an exhaustive nuisance envelope; no winning corner promoted
config.registration: parameters retained from prior scalar audits; method declared after source schema and release-alignment inspection but before candidate pressure scoring; not blind confirmation; v2 adds a declared constant covariance-radius normalization after preflight-only failure, before any candidate pressure scoring

scoring.additional_loss: equal-cluster mean covariance-whitened squared pressure residual per target, conditional on source mapping
scoring.leave_one: remove largest absolute candidate-minus-baseline object contribution
scoring.symmetric_trim: remove one smallest and one largest comparative object contribution among eight

selection.reason: published Planck beam/deconvolution limitation, Ghirardini2019 section 2.5

source_mapping.boundary: outermost usable SZ pressure point is measured boundary and never scored; its correlated uncertainty is propagated
source_mapping.density: published electron density, log-linear between source knots, constant density to zero inside first knot; exact piecewise-power mass integration independent of target radii
source_mapping.geometry: published cosmological distance and spherical reconstruction are conditional source assumptions; R500/P500 are used to undo release units, never as candidate mass predictors
source_mapping.gravity: exact regular spherical QUMOND relation for joint baryonic enclosed mass; not an arbitrary local disk approximation
source_mapping.missing_stellar: one shared stellar/gas mass ratio for the three missing-profile clusters, with predeclared sensitivity
source_mapping.pressure: d[P_e/(1-f)]/dr=-mu*m_p*n_e*g; f=f_out*r/r_anchor is the isotropic nonthermal fraction of total pressure
source_mapping.stellar: published cumulative stellar profile with recorded monotone correction, cubic enclosed-mass continuation to origin, constant mass beyond outer stellar support; shared normalization only
source_mapping.temperature: unsupported projected-spectroscopic response; no temperature scores and no local P_e/n_e versus projected temperature comparison

sources.role: projected X-ray temperature, deprojected SZ pressure, covariance and inner-three-bin exclusion
total-pressure hydrostatic equation and definition of nonthermal pressure fraction
